node.statement: Uniform raw-map bound. Lem-routef-raw-factor-norms gives ||tilde-Delta||_cb<=1+C_T eta because eta<=rho_3<=rho_Delta_prime<=rho_T. From def-routef-raw-factor-setting, C_T=C_theta+3C_V and rho_T<=1/[4(1+C_theta)] and rho_T<=1/[4(1+C_V)]. Hence C_theta eta<=1/4 and 3C_V eta<=3/4, so C_T eta<=1 and ||tilde-Delta||_cb<=2.
